recognize_zh: 這是骨盆腔股骨頭下方層級的增強電腦斷層（CT）橫切面，箭頭指向肛門直腸旁的軟組織腫脹與不均勻增強；在藥物引起嗜中性球低下的病人，這代表肛周／直腸周圍膿瘍（perirectal abscess）這類常見感染併發症。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the pelvis at the level of the proximal femora
Arrow indicates asymmetric soft-tissue thickening with heterogeneous enhancement in the perirectal/perianal region
Surrounding fat planes appear hazy, suggesting inflammatory stranding
No discrete gas collection clearly identifiable at this image resolution
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT image of the lower pelvis at the level of the proximal femora shows asymmetric soft-tissue thickening with heterogeneous enhancement in the perirectal/perianal region (arrow), with haziness of adjacent fat. A well-defined rim-enhancing fluid collection or gas is not clearly resolved on this single image. In a neutropenic patient, this appearance is consistent with a perirectal inflammatory process/abscess; notably, neutropenic patients may show little fluid or pus because of the absence of neutrophils. This is a radiologic image and does not provide hematologic morphology.
